_about: The owner's Full Body NPC Lineup board (docs/reference/npc-lineup-full-body.png) as Meshy text-to-3D jobs, run by tools/meshy_lineup.sh once api.meshy.ai is reachable (owner, Nov 22: 'Fix all characters ... realistic GTA V quality destiny quality cyberpunk quality', route 'Unblock Meshy'). Every job: preview -> refine (PBR) -> remesh 30k -> rig (humanoid, walking + running) -> GLB into models/characters/<id>.glb, then tools/meshy_prep_rig.py and scripts/check-meshy-textures.py. 'slot' says where it goes in the game: operator = the player's everyday body (headless_person.py cut, the creator's face on it), people = catalog.gd PEOPLE (whole characters, own face), police / enemy / npc = the matching roster.
style: realistic GTA V style full body character, photoreal skin and fabric, A-pose, arms 45 degrees from the body, standing straight, neutral grey background, PBR textures, game-ready
